commands.cmd: cd /Users/wane/Synova-过程档案/出库-主仓 && find .claude/task-briefs/archive -name '*.md' | wc -l

git ls-tree -r --name-only ff467712 .claude/task-briefs/archive/ > /tmp/b1a/base-paths.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  h=$(git cat-file blob "ff467712:$p" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$h" "$p"
done < /tmp/b1a/base-paths.txt | sort -k2 > /tmp/b1a/base.sha256
wc -l < /tmp/b1a/base.sha256

cd /Users/wane/Synova-过程档案/出库-主仓 && find .claude/task-briefs/archive -name '*.md' | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | sort -k2 > /tmp/b1a/dst.sha256
wc -l < /tmp/b1a/dst.sha256

awk 'NR%15==1{print $2}' /tmp/b1a/base.sha256 > /tmp/b1a/cmp20.txt
ok=0; fail=0
while IFS= read -r p; do
  git -C /Users/wane/SynovaAgent/.synova-wt-b1-d1044 cat-file blob "ff467712:$p" > /tmp/b1a/.cmpbase
  if cmp -s /tmp/b1a/.cmpbase "/Users/wane/Synova-过程档案/出库-主仓/$p"; then echo "CMP_OK   $p"; ok=$((ok+1)); else echo "CMP_FAIL $p"; fail=$((fail+1)); fi
done < /tmp/b1a/cmp20.txt
echo "--- cmp summary: OK=$ok FAIL=$fail  (sample size $(wc -l < /tmp/b1a/cmp20.txt)) ---"

notes.b7_测量修正: 首测（rec/b7.out）用 `git diff-tree --name-only` 默认 core.quotepath=true，非 ASCII 路径被八进制转义成 "\345..."，导致 `grep -vc '^出库-主仓/'` 误判 294 为『非该前缀』。修正为 `-c core.quotepath=false` 后：前缀内 294 / 非前缀 0 / 前缀内非 archive/*.md 0。原始两版输出俱在（b7.out 误判版 + b7b.out 修正版）。
notes.对账强度: diff 比较的是 {sha256, path} 成对集合 ⇒ 同时证明『件数相同 + 路径集合相同 + 字节内容相同』，非仅数量相等。
